title: Zetta-Joule hero
description: A sky-blue-to-peach gradient hero with a gigantic featherlight (weight 250) two-line headline, the second line split into an indented word and a right-aligned word around a tall centred product render, and a small subtitle with a hairline at the bottom-left. On phones the headline stacks above the render. The render drifts down as the hero scrolls out.
notes: forces the dark colour scope (white text on the sky gradient); the gradient is glow → chart-5
the media is a transparent PNG taller than wide; the placeholder sits behind the headline (the original puts the render in front of it)
fixed height (757px phones / 900px desktop), like the original; not window-sized
CSS only; the drift is off under reduced motion
